description: Defines the StockGridReport class extending frappe.views.TreeGridReport, implementing inventory valuation and FIFO logic with methods for calculating value differences, FIFO stack management, and serial number rate retrieval.

classes.name: StockGridReport
classes.description: A class for managing stock inventory reports with FIFO and serial number valuation logic.

methods.name: get_item_warehouse
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes warehouse data for a specific item.

methods.name: get_value_diff
methods.description: Calculates the value difference for stock movements, updating warehouse balances.

methods.name: get_fifo_value_diff
methods.description: Calculates FIFO-based value difference for stock outgoing.

methods.name: get_serialized_value_diff
methods.description: Calculates value difference based on serial numbers' buying rates.

methods.name: get_serialized_buying_rates
methods.description: Retrieves a mapping of serial numbers to their incoming rates.
